title: SK hynix Inc. (NASDAQ: SKHY): Breached Stop, Q3 6-K Capex Surge & Stage 4 Parity Test
holding_rationale: Live close ($103.57) breached our prior $116.28 structural stop by 10.9% on 39.86M shares (1.69x avg volume). The S&P 500 sits in a 10-distribution-day Downtrend with only 38.8% breadth above the 50-DMA. Upward-only ratchet rules forbid lowering stops or averaging down into Stage 4 (CAP_REJECTED, -34.04% vs. $157.01 50D SMA). Exit all 17.764 Schwab shares (~$1,839.82) immediately. Selling removes exposure to $10.33–$10.34 daily ATR swings (9.98% of close) and 8.11% weekly / 6.01% monthly Finviz volatility (beta '-'). This protects capital from deeper downside toward $81.58 KRX parity or $60.06 cycle-compression stress.

primer: SK hynix holds 50%–58% of global HBM sales and ~70% of early HBM4 supply. Yet Q3 2026 filings flagged 24.87% two-buyer share, 83.7% cash conversion on KRW 59.12T ending receivables (+KRW 47.44T CFO drag), and KRW 42.71T in capex pledges. On November 20, 2026, SKHY fell 13.11% to $103.57 in Stage 4 and broke our $116.28 stop. We rate quality CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL (PASS_WITH_WATCH) and new capital REJECTED (TIER_0, TREND/VALUATION; $73.24 Base). For our 17.764 Schwab shares, we issue EXIT_IMMEDIATELY (~$1,839.82) into 100% cash.
